It changes who yogis are off the mat, making their lives and their communities better. That’s the real meaning of studio-to-street: taking the consciousness from practice on the mat and putting it into practice in life. This leader combines operational discipline, innovation, and mindful leadership to protect both performance and brand experience across diverse regulatory, cultural, and risk environments. The Director is responsible for developing, standardizing, and scaling a comprehensive international retail protection program across the UK, Europe, and APAC. This role integrates operational risk management, safety governance, investigations, and resilience into a cohesive strategy that positions ALO’s Asset Protection & Safety organization as a global center of excellence for protection and prevention. This role will report into the Sr. Director Asset Protection & Safety This leader is both visionary and practical, using data, technology, and human insight to anticipate emerging risks and create scalable solutions that sustain trust, profitability, and operational excellence across international markets. The role partners across Operations, People & Culture, Legal, Finance, IT, Facilities, and Supply Chain to ensure ALO’s protection and safety programs evolve ahead of industry trends while remaining compliant with local laws and cultural expectations. jobs.description: Mission Brief  The Chief Quality Inspector is the independent authority responsible for defining how product conformity is verified across manufacturing operations. This role establishes inspection strategies, verification methods, conformity assessment criteria, and competency standards to ensure objective evidence exists that every product meets defined requirements. The position is driving a quality-at-source culture and a scalable inspection framework capable of supporting company growth. The Chief Quality Inspector ensures inspection activities provide reliable product acceptance decisions and robust evidence of compliance throughout the manufacturing lifecycle. Your Role in Our Space Mission:  Define and govern the company inspection strategy, acceptance approaches, and verification methodologies. Establish conformity assessment criteria and ensure objective evidence supports all product acceptance decisions. Own inspection governance, standards, procedures, and inspection-related competency frameworks. Lead laboratory functions including material testing, metallography, composite testing, calibration activities, and failure investigations. Support process qualification activities by defining required verification and inspection evidence. Drive implementation of quality-at-source principles across manufacturing operations. Ensure inspection resources, technologies, and capabilities can scale with future production demand. Develop and maintain inspector training, qualification, certification, and recertification requirements. Partner with Manufacturing, Production Engineering, Product Assurance, and Supplier Quality to resolve conformity concerns and improve product quality. Provide clear conformity recommendations and inspection performance reporting to senior leadership. jobs.title: Staff Applied Scientist, Location Intelligence
jobs.description: Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction . Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people , making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone. THE TEAM • ~160 people , around half in engineering, product and data • 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research • Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle • An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking , tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation Every parcel ends at a door. Where that door is, where a courier can park, and which way they walk in decide whether a handover takes seconds or minutes, and whether anyone ends up at the wrong place at all. Most of that never shows up on a map. Relay sees the last mile through couriers' own devices: GPS traces from live deliveries that show where they park, which entrance they use and how long each handover takes. Turning those traces into a trusted picture of the real last mile is the foundation the rest of our Science builds on. Science at Relay is the brain of the operation: machine learning, operational research, recommender systems, causal inference, location intelligence and experimentation, working together to decide how every parcel gets delivered. Location intelligence is where it starts. Location Intelligence Highlights Telematics from the couriers who deliver for us: GPS traces, stops, parking spots and building entr

We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days. We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes. Join us if you want to Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1 Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions Build the best technology in-house : we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting This role combines applied AI engineering, process design and hands-on Python development. jobs.description: Qdrant is an open-source vector search engine powering the next generation of AI applications, from semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to AI agents and real-time recommendations. Trusted by global leaders like Canva, HubSpot, Tripadvisor, Bosch, and Deutsche Telekom , we’re building the retrieval infrastructure layer for modern AI. Recently raising $50M in Series B funding, we are growing rapidly and committed to transforming how AI understands and interacts with data. As a remote-first company, we believe diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences fuel innovation. Here, you’ll own meaningful work, tackle challenges, and grow alongside passionate individuals dedicated to shaping the future of AI. The Team and Your Impact Hi, I'm Gio , and I lead People & Culture at Qdrant. I joined in April 2026 to build the People function from scratch. We have laid the foundations: went live with Ashby and with a new HRIS, launched our first engagement survey, a leveling framework, and our first review and compensation cycles are coming in 2027. Our colleagues are spread across about 30 countries, and our People team is small by design. We need systems that scale as Qdrant does. As our Senior People Operations Engineer, you’ll build how People Ops runs, write the policies behind it, and automate every process that doesn’t need a human touch. You don't need "People Operations Engineer" in your title to apply. If you are an HR generalist who automates everything, or an HR systems person who has handled multi-country cases, we want to hear from you. What you will own About 60% of your time goes to running People Ops, and about 40% to building. The mix will shift with what the business needs. jobs.title: Growth Associate
jobs.description: Our Mission Human time and effort is the rarest thing in the universe. The fact that so many people hate what they do for work is a disaster on so many levels. How many people live quiet lives of misery? How many generational talents do we miss due to circumstance? Dex’s mission is to close the gap between Talent & Opportunity, we believe that work, and being productive, is part of the human condition, that regardless of AI, human passion, ingenuity and a desire to do things means that work will always exist. We are building Dex to create a future where technology helps every individual to understand their strengths, interests and unique abilities, and to connect with opportunities where they can thrive, because more people doing things they love leads to a better, happier and more productive world. We are starting by connecting the world's most ambitious software engineers with the companies that deserve them. About Dex Dex is backed by Notion Capital, a16z and Concept Ventures, with angels from OpenAI, Wise, ElevenLabs, Meta’s board, and many more. We’re an ambitious, direct and kind group of people, we value authenticity, ambition and people who make things happen. We’re a team of 28 (and growing) based in London. We work together 3 times a week because we value in person time, but we’re person centric and flexible. We hire adults who can manage their own schedules. The Role 40,000+ engineers have joined Dex, and we plan to 10x that in the next year. To get there we’re building a growth engine: channels, tools and agents that find the right engineers and get better every week. This role helps build and run it. It’s a broad role on the candidate side of Dex. One week you might launch a new acquisition channel. The next you might build a lead magnet, run a test on the website or ship a free tool like our engineer salary benchmark . What ties it together is systems: you’ll build the automations, agents and reporting that let a small team do the work of a much bigger

jobs.description: About Allica Bank Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech. Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers. Role Description As a Senior Business Development Manager in our Invoice Finance team, you'll take on a more complex and higher-value origination remit, working the largest and most strategically important opportunities across our acquisition channels. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, take the lead on more sophisticated deal structures, and act as a role model and informal mentor to more junior members of the BDM team, while continuing to personally originate and close new business. jobs.description: About the Role As a Data Architect, you will shape data-driven solutions from strategic consulting through technical implementation. You will work with an experienced, interdisciplinary team of data engineers, AI specialists, and software developers to build scalable data platforms and architectures that support business needs. What You'll Do Analyze customer requirements and identify opportunities for solutions spanning analytics, machine learning, and generative AI. Develop tailored data and AI strategies for a range of use cases. Design scalable architectures for data platforms, machine learning pipelines, and AI systems. Evaluate and recommend technologies, and guide implementation teams with clear roadmaps. Contribute to pre-sales, market analysis, solution concepts, estimates, and presentations. Help develop data-driven business areas and advance architecture standards. What We're Looking For At least 3 years of experience designing and implementing modern data platforms, machine learning solutions, and AI systems. A degree in computer science, business informatics, informatics, or a comparable qualification. Hands-on experience with Azure, Databricks, or AWS, plus Python, SQL, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code. Strong knowledge of modern data architectures, MLOps, and data governance. Experience developing data-driven solutions across analytics, machine learning, and generative AI, and shaping strategies for varied use cases. Strong analytical, communication, and practical problem-solving skills. German proficiency at C1 level and English proficiency at B2 level. Compensation & Benefits Visa sponsorship is not available. jobs.description: BlockTech is hiring a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join its Tech department in Amsterdam. Crypto markets never close, and neither does our trading. Bare-metal hosts, cloud instances, exchange connectivity, messaging, and the trading services on top all have to work around the clock. In this role, you'll sit between infrastructure, engineering, and trading, and follow every problem wherever it leads. About BlockTech BlockTech is an algorithmic trading firm headquartered in Amsterdam, with a second office in Singapore. We specialize in market making and trade cryptocurrency derivatives and spot markets globally, using our own capital. We're growing fast and expanding into new markets. We trade options and delta one around the clock on the largest crypto venues. Our platform runs on a Linux bare-metal fleet alongside cloud deployments in the regions where exchanges run, with services written in Python and Rust. What will you do? You will make sure everything works, and works properly. Most problems don't stay inside one team's boundaries: a strange fill might come from a network issue, a config change, or an exchange that changed its behavior without telling anyone. You understand what each service does for trading, what it costs when it breaks, and which fix matters most right now. You own an issue from the first alert to the long-term fix that stops it coming back. You will: Own the live environment. Monitor trading across all our venues, take charge of incidents, and own both the immediate fix and the long-term one. Bridge infrastructure, engineering, and trading. Translate a trader's “something looks off” into a root cause, and a root cause into a priority the right team can act on. Partner with the desk. Work closely with traders and quants, so reliability work is driven by what actually matters for PnL and risk. Debug across the full stack. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Financial Statement Suite
jobs.description: Before a company publishes its annual report, finance teams have to turn financial data into a complete set of statements and disclosures. Balances need to be mapped, figures carried forward and updated, and supporting information brought together into a draft. Auditors then check that the notes match the primary statements, this year reconciles with last year, and every total adds up. Preparing and reviewing those statements takes days of detailed work, and errors can carry through into a published report. Today, audit teams rely on Financial Statement Suite (FSS) to read statements, run checks, and show reviewers what it found and where, so they can make the call and stand behind it. The opportunity goes beyond reconciliation: helping auditors and financial professionals review drafts, connect figures to supporting evidence, and manage changes through to sign-off. You'll own what FSS becomes across preparation and review cycles. You'll decide what sits on the teams roadmap and define strategy for this high opportunity area working with engineering, design, audit experts and the firms who use FSS every day. About DataSnipper The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust. We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable. At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important. For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. jobs.description: TenMedia ist ein erfolgreiches Softwareunternehmen im Herzen Berlins. Wir sind seit über 14 Jahren auf den Betrieb und die Entwicklung von Individualsoftware spezialisiert. Wir suchen ab sofort einen Praktikanten (m/w/d) im Bereich Fachinformatik für Anwendungsentwicklung. Wir glauben an die Stärke und das Potenzial unseres Teams und sind stets bemüht, dass Beste aus uns herauszuholen. Als Praktikant wirst du Teil dieses Teams. Dabei folgst du unserem strukturierten Ausbildungsplan, der darauf ausgerichtet ist, dich innerhalb kürzester Zeit zum Profi zu machen. Neben dem Programmieren stehen auch Tools und Prozesse wie Microsoft DevOps, Scrum und Git im Fokus. Sobald du dich sattelfest fühlst, erhältst du erste Einblicke in echte Projekte und kannst diese erkunden und kleinere Tasks umsetzen, frei von Termindruck und Deadlines. Aufgaben Das erwartet dich: Praktische Erfahrungen in einem schlagkräftigen Unternehmen, das sich auf die Entwicklung von Individualsoftware und Online-Plattformen spezialisiert hat Moderne Stacks, kein Wordpress, Joomla o.ä. jobs.title: Graduate Operations Supervisor (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Kurz und knapp Du hast dein Studium in der Tasche, sprühst vor Energie und willst nicht nur zuschauen, sondern echte Verantwortung übernehmen? Bei Picnic startest du direkt in einer Führungsrolle durch! Als Graduate Operations Supervisor (m/w/d) in unserem teilautomatisierten Fulfillment Center (FC) in Falkensee bist du der Motor des Standorts. Unterstützt von Investoren wie der Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation bauen wir gemeinsam das modernste, 100 % elektrische Liefersystem Europas. Sei von Anfang an dabei: Im August 2027 eröffnen wir unser neues teilautomatisiertes FC in Falkensee. Du kannst aber schon früher bei uns starten und dein Onboarding an einem unserer bestehenden Standorte absolvieren - zum Beispiel in unserem manuellen FC in Ludwigsfelde oder unserem vollautomatisierten FC in Oberhausen. So bekommst du einen umfassenden Einblick in unsere Operations und bist bestens vorbereitet, wenn wir in Falkensee an den Start gehen. Das erwartet dich  Teamleitung: Du bist Coach und Vorbild – mit deinem echten, intrinsischen Interesse an Menschen führst und inspirierst du dein Team aus 5 Lead Shoppers und über 150 Shoppers. Schichtleitung: Im FC behältst du stets den Überblick, priorisierst Aufgaben im Tagesgeschäft und sorgst dafür, dass jede Bestellung pünktlich rausgeht. Abwechslung: Du erlebst den perfekten Mix aus Action direkt auf der Lagerfläche (4 Tage pro Woche) und strategischem Deep Dive im FC Office (1 Tag pro Woche). Prozessoptimierung: Stillstand gibt es bei uns nicht. Du hast Ideen? Hier entwickelst du eigene Logistikprojekte und hebst unsere Abläufe durch deinen Tatendrang aufs nächste Level. Ownership: Du hast Lust, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, auch wenn Dinge mal außerhalb deines unmittelbaren Bereichs liegen. Du schaust über den Tellerrand hinaus und nimmst die Dinge proaktiv selbst in die Hand. jobs.title: Chef d'équipe logistique (H/F)
jobs.description: En bref Picnic grandit vite, et notre centre de préparation de commandes de Fretin a besoin de pilotes pour porter cette ambition. En tant que Captain, tu n es pas juste un(e) chef(fe) d équipe : tu es le moteur de l entrepôt. Ton défi ? Manager environ 20 Shoppers (préparateur(rice)s de commandes) en direct, garantir une sécurité totale et transformer chaque shift en succès collectif avec +100 Shoppers sur le terrain. Si tu aimes l action et que tu sais fédérer une équipe dans la bonne humeur, ce rôle est pour toi. Tes missions Manager et coacher ton équipe : Tu supervises une vingtaine de Shoppers au quotidien, en veillant à leur motivation, leur sécurité et au respect des bonnes pratiques. Piloter la performance : Tu garantis que chaque commande est prête, complète et à l heure, en suivant de près nos indicateurs de qualité. Coordonner les flux du FC : Tu travailles main dans la main avec les autres Captains pour fluidifier les opérations et ajuster les ressources en temps réel. Assurer la polyvalence opérationnelle : Réception, gestion des stocks (sec, frais, surgelé) ou départ des camions... tu navigues entre les zones selon les besoins du planning. Gérer l humain et le terrain : Tu es le point de contact privilégié pour ton équipe, capable de recadrer avec pédagogie comme de féliciter les réussites. Organisation du temps de travail : 35 heures travaillées réparties sur 4 jours par semaine. 3 jours de repos chaque semaine. Travail le week-end, dimanche inclus, à raison de 3 semaines par mois. Des shifts tournants selon les besoins de l activité. À propos de toi Tu as entre 1 et 5 ans d expérience dans un environnement dynamique (logistique, retail, restauration ou ligne de production) avec une première gestion d équipe réussie. Tu maîtrises le français (l anglais est un plus) et tu es parfaitement à l aise avec les outils digitaux de pilotage. Tu es véhiculé(e) pour rejoindre facilement l entrepôt de Fretin. jobs.description: About IonQ:  IonQ, Inc . [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance . Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.   What to expect We are looking for a Staff System Architect to be fully dedicated to the SNSPD product line, with a strong focus on leading the technical architecture and roadmap for our next-generation rack-mountable SNSPD (Superconducting Nanowire Single-Photon Detector) platform. This role is critical to defining and guiding the technical evolution of our cutting-edge cryogenic photon detection systems, ensuring architectural coherence across hardware, software, and integration domains while supporting our product vision and market requirements. We enable virtual machines to communicate reliably by abstracting them from the underlying physical network, providing seamless IP-based connectivity even as workloads move across the datacenter. Our team designs secure, isolated private networks for customers, connects them to the public internet, and delivers essential networking services such as load balancers, firewalls, and security groups. Because nearly every cloud application depends on networking, VPC is a foundational service for the entire platform. Stability and resilience are our top priorities—we engineer systems to remain reliable and operational even when parts of the cloud experience failures. Our team both develops the control-plane, written in Golang, and supports open-source based dataplane, written mostly in C. We use our profits to fund research on the most important problems in AI Safety and Alignment. We partner with top researchers from both academia and industry, including Anthropic, Goodfire AI, Redwood, Princeton, MATS, RAND Corporation, and others. We take the same client-centric approach to research, partnering with the world’s best external researchers to develop world-class results. We research a diverse set of ambitious alignment directions that others neglect, including pretraining interventions for model safety, novel interpretability techniques, neuroscience-inspired approaches to alignment, and many others. jobs.description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO Shape the architecture of the world’s first commercial fusion power plant – Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale. Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges – Work across tightly coupled disciplines (plasma physics, magnets, cryogenics, manufacturing, controls, and more) to resolve critical trade-offs and turn cutting-edge science into a functioning product. Design real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world – Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy. jobs.description: Set a new pulse for healthcare! We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the Doctolib Connect team in Amsterdam. Doctolib Connect is a secure medical communication app designed for healthcare professionals. More than 1M healthcare professionals use Doctolib Connect to discuss and coordinate patient care with colleagues, both within and beyond their organizational walls. Today, Doctolib Connect is the largest medical network in Europe. You'll work closely with a talented team to develop user-friendly products that meet market demands, such as tele-expertise or patient referral flows. What you'll do As a Senior Product Manager on the Doctolib Connect team, you will drive the development of products that strengthen care cooperation among healthcare professionals. Working at the heart of a cross-functional team, you will shape products that serve over 900,000 users across our network, combining a user-centric and data-driven approach with a focus on network effects and long-term impact. Success in this role means growing Doctolib Connect's network, launching products that achieve product-market fit, and delivering measurable value for both our users and the business. Your responsibilities include but are not limited to: Contributing to our product strategy to grow Doctolib Connect , identifying opportunities that strengthen the network and deliver user and business value Defining, shipping, and iterating on new products and features by analysing data, conducting user interviews, researching competitors, and leveraging cross-functional insights Continuously measuring adoption, impact, and network health, iterating as needed to achieve desired outcomes for your product and company goals Collaborating with engineering, design, and research teams to translate insights into hypotheses, experiments, and features that delight users and grow Doctolib Connect's network Working closely with cross-functional teams including sales, marketing, support, and company leaders

jobs.description: Who are we? The sea is the physical layer of the economy: our energy, data and trade move across it and under it. It is also Europe's most exposed flank. Cheap underwater drones, divers and mines now threaten ports, naval bases, subsea cables and offshore energy sites, and most of what is funded today stops at detection: it tells you a drone has entered the harbour, not how to stop it before it reaches the hull or the cable. Pelagon is creating the category of maritime interdiction : detection and action together. We design, deploy and operate protection zones around critical maritime infrastructure: a persistent sensing network running our own acoustic-first AI detects and classifies threats, and an underwater interceptor acts on them. We sell to navies and coast guards , and to the civilian operators of ports, subsea cables and offshore energy. Pelagon was founded by Aymeric de Pontbriand (serial deeptech entrepreneur, founded and exited Scortex) and Gauthier Bouxin (French Navy officer, then McKinsey). A team is already in place around them: a lead embedded systems engineer, a lead hardware engineer and an a chief of staff. We are backed by Hexa , the pioneer startup studio in Europe behind Front, Aircall and Spendesk. ⚡ What is at stake in the coming months Confirm the technology at sea with navies and operators. Deploy and sign our first paid pilots. Sign our first contracts. By joining us, you'll play a key role in turning that early traction into multi-year protection contracts, and in building the sales team that follows. 🎯 Your mission Own every deal from first meeting to signed contract, with navies, port authorities and operators of cables and offshore energy. Sell interdiction, not detection alone: make the threat and the gap between alarm and response concrete for each buyer, then turn pilots into multi-year protection contracts. jobs.description: Rohlik wurde 2014 in der Tschechischen Republik gegründet und ist der europäische Marktführer im Bereich E-Grocery in Mitteleuropa. Das Unternehmen ist bereits in der Tschechischen Republik ( Rohlik.cz ), Ungarn ( Kifli.hu ), Österreich ( Gurkerl.at ), Deutschland ( Knuspr.de ) und weiteren Märkten aktiv. Durch die vollständige Kontrolle über die gesamte Wertschöpfungskette, einschließlich der hauseigen entwickelten Technologie, bietet Rohlik ein herausragendes Kundenerlebnis sowie die frischesten Lebensmittel von lokalen Landwirten und Manufakturen neben einer breiten Auswahl an Supermarktprodukten. Abteilung Das Facility & Engineering Team sorgt für einen sicheren, zuverlässigen und effizienten täglichen Betrieb unserer Fulfillment Center, indem es Infrastruktur, Anlagen und technische Systeme instand hält. Durch vorbeugende und korrektive Instandhaltung minimieren wir betriebliche Risiken und ermöglichen eine kontinuierlich hohe Leistungsfähigkeit. Deine Rolle Als Techniker:in bist du für die Instandhaltung und Zuverlässigkeit der technischen Anlagen und der Infrastruktur unseres Lagers verantwortlich. jobs.description: Help make the world more hospitable The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences. You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building. If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here. About the role Let s get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this: You would own Mews relationships with the press, turning company news, product launches and leadership insight into credible coverage across hospitality, travel, technology and business media. This is a new role, the first dedicated media relations seat at Mews, so the contacts you build and the way you work will set the standard for how we deal with the press. Hospitality technology offers good stories and unusual data to pitch, and leaders here respond to press requests within about a day. You would join the Communications team within Marketing and work closely with the communications lead, the colleagues who shape our stories, and leadership, product marketing and regional marketing. Day to day you would pitch journalists directly, host press briefings, handle inbound enquiries and prepare leaders to speak well in front of the press. The role is remote first in Europe, ideally near London, Berlin or Paris where many of the journalists we work with are based, with about 10% travel to meet press and attend events such as Unfold. The explosive growth of AI is pushing the industry to rethink how processors are built. Arago is meeting that challenge with a proprietary technology that fuses optical and CMOS technologies to deliver an order-of-magnitude increase in performance. jobs.title: Senior Manager, Revenue Operations, DashOS EMEA
jobs.description: About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe. Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. About the Team DashOS is DoorDash's merchant technology platform. It brings together the products restaurants and local businesses use to run their own business, sell on their own channels and keep their guests coming back, including online ordering, websites and apps, and loyalty. DashOS connects these tools with the demand and growth learnings of the DoorDash, Wolt and Deliveroo marketplaces, so merchants can grow both on our marketplaces and on their own channels. In EMEA, we are building DashOS market by market. The team is small and works like a startup within the larger DoorDash. When joining DashOS, you will help shape a new business from an early stage: what we offer merchants to fuel their growth, how we take it to market and how we support merchants once they are live. Our Strategy & Operations team builds the DashOS business end to end in EMEA: what we focus on, how we measure success, and the playbooks that make growth repeatable. We work in small cross-functional pods that find improvement opportunities, launch and iterate, together with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Finance, Legal, Marketing, our merchant and consumer teams. About the Role We are now looking for a Senior Manager, Revenue Operations to build the commercial engine behind DashO

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - Safety
jobs.description: About Black Forest Labs We're the team behind Latent Diffusion, Stable Diffusion, and FLUX—foundational technologies that changed how the world creates images and video. We're creating the generative models that power how people make images and video—tools used by millions of creators, developers, and businesses worldwide. Our FLUX models are among the most advanced in the world, and we're just getting started. Headquartered in Freiburg, Germany with a growing presence in San Francisco, we're scaling fast while staying true to what makes us different: research excellence, open science, and building technology that expands human creativity. Why this role FLUX models ship as open weights, which gives anyone full access to the model. Our safety efforts focus on suppressing harmful behaviors and mitigating the risk of misuse, so safety has to be built into the models themselves, not bolted on afterwards. As a Member of Technical Staff on our safety research team, you'll research and ship methods that make FLUX models safe by design: from what goes into the training data to how the models are mid- and post-trained, across images, video and the text that conditions them. This is a role with real ownership: you won't just do research on model safety, you'll shape it. The methods you build ship in FLUX models with over 75 million downloads on Hugging Face and in production at some of the largest platforms in the world. What you'll work on Develop mid- and post-training safety methods for FLUX models, such as safety SFT, preference optimization and RL with safety rewards, and concept erasure. Build safety data filtering that runs at pretraining scale: classifiers and pipelines that screen billions of images, video clips and captions, with measured Pareto frontiers and precision/recall trade-offs. jobs.description: Als Verkaufsberater im Flagship Store machst du unsere Pergolen für Kund erlebbar und begleitest sie vom ersten Gespräch bis zum Kaufabschluss. Du verstehst ihre Wünsche, präsentierst Produkte und Zubehör und empfiehlst die passende Lösung für ihren Außenbereich. Dabei betreust du deine Kundenkontakte eigenverantwortlich, fasst Angebote verbindlich nach und gestaltest mit, wie Kund PERGOLUX in unserem Flagship Store erleben. PERGOLUX entwirft und verkauft skandinavisch inspirierte Outdoor-Living-Produkte wie Pergolen und Gartenmöbel direkt an Endkund. Mit rund 300 Mitarbeiter, einem neunstelligen Umsatz und Aktivitäten in acht Märkten sind wir über die Jahre stetig gewachsen – in Europa und darüber hinaus. Deine Aufgaben Kund:innen beraten: Du findest heraus, was unsere Kund für ihren Außenbereich brauchen, und empfiehlst passende Pergolen, Ausstattungsvarianten und Zubehör. Produkte erlebbar machen: Du führst unsere Produkte im Flagship Store vor und erklärst Funktionen, Materialien und Maße verständlich und anschaulich. Abschlüsse erzielen: Du erstellst Angebote, klärst Rückfragen und fasst verbindlich nach – persönlich, telefonisch und per E-Mail. Deine Verkaufsgespräche begleitest du eigenverantwortlich bis zum Abschluss. Den Überblick behalten: Du dokumentierst Kundenwünsche, Angebote, Termine und nächste Schritte im CRM und hältst vereinbarte Rückmeldungen zuverlässig ein. Mit anpacken: Du hältst den Flagship Store gepflegt und vorführbereit, bringst Ideen für die Produktpräsentation ein und unterstützt Verkaufsaktionen. Dein Profil Freude am Verkauf: Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu, hörst aufmerksam zu und überzeugst mit Lösungen, die zu ihren Bedürfnissen passen. Passende Erfahrung: Idealerweise bringst du Erfahrung im beratungsintensiven Verkauf mit – etwa mit Terrassenüberdachungen, Fenstern, Türen, Wintergärten, Bauelementen, Möbeln oder Küchen. Technisches Verständnis: Du kannst mit Maßen, Materialien und Produktdetails umgehen und möchtest dir fundiertes

jobs.description: Who we are We believe travel can create Citizens of the World. When people cross Europe slowly, by train, they come back more curious, more open and better able to understand people unlike themselves. With colleagues from more than 50 countries, our diversity sparks curiosity, insight and a culture of openness, which is essential to understanding our travellers and one another. Three values connect everyone at Interrail: we lead with our purpose, we own our impact, and we choose for growth. We work in a hybrid way, from our office in Utrecht and our homes across the Netherlands. We’re on the search for... Someone who has built a community for a brand before, and who can bring ours to life online and offline. Since 1959, Interrail has been more than a rail pass. We’re now building it into a cultural movement, and our community is where that movement becomes real: the deeper you travel through Europe, the more the journey changes you, told by the people who lived it. In 2027 our community moves into the Interrail app and website. Our product and technical team builds the platform. You make it a community: you shape the community vision, bring the first members in, and create the moments, online and in real life, that make travellers come back and help each other. The Brand team shapes what Interrail stands for and how it shows up wherever travellers meet us. We own our brand platform and positioning, and our community, bringing The Interrail Effect to life through the people who’ve travelled with us. We work closely with Product, Social & Community, Creative & Content, CRM, and the PR & Partnerships teams to keep every touchpoint consistent and culturally sharp. This is a nine-month interim contract. The team meets in the office a minimum of twice per week, so you’ll be required to join those days to work alongside your colleagues. Fondée en 2015, elle compte aujourd’hui 20 000 clients et 1M utilisateurs dans 98 pays , faisant de N2F l’un des leaders du marché français. N2F simplifie la gestion des frais professionnels : photo des justificatifs, reconnaissance automatique, validation, export comptable, archivage à valeur probante , etc. L’objectif : faire gagner du temps aux entreprises tout en sécurisant leurs processus internes. Après une croissance progressive, l’équipe est passée de 20 personnes en 2021 à 230 aujourd’hui , portée par le succès produit et l’expansion internationale. Nous partageons un objectif commun : devenir le leader européen de la gestion des notes de frais et des factures fournisseurs. En 2021, N2JSoft a élargi son expertise avec Keeple , un logiciel RH dédié aux congés, absences et temps de travail (hors périmètre de ce poste). Quelques chiffres 230 collaborateurs , dont 50 dans l'équipe tech Notre site est basé à Montagnat (01) avec un format de télétravail hybride ou full remote. L’équipe tech Notre équipe est composée de développeurs/euses full stack expérimenté(e)s , réparti(e)s en squads : Notes de frais, Cartes de paiement pro, Invoices, Core… Chaque squad réunit : développeurs/euses, tech lead, team lead, product manager et testeur/euses QA. Stack et pratiques Front : Angular 16/21 Back : .NET 10 – C# Infra : AWS BDD : MSSQL, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB Architecture : monolithe modulaire Bonnes pratiques : tests unitaires, revues de code, pair programming, couverture Qodana, Microsoft Release Flow. Méthodo : Agile Scrum, sprints de 2 semaines (daily, weekly, rétro, planning). Le profil recherché Rattaché(e) à un(e) Team Lead dans l'une des squads produit, tu disposes : D'une formation en informatique Bac+3 minimum De 3 ans d’expérience en .NET / C# (web ou backend) De 2 ans d'expérience sur Angular et de bonnes connaissances front-end (HTML/CSS, TypeScript)

jobs.title: UI Designer - Casual Games (Freelance Remote)
jobs.description: We’re looking for a UI designer who loves casual games. You know what makes a game feel intuitive and fun to play, and you can turn that into clean, good-looking UI. You’ll be assisting the SOHO Art team and reporting directly to our Game Art Lead. Heads up: we’ll ask you to do a short graphics assignment as part of the process. What you’ll be doing: Creating UI assets - designing visually appealing interfaces that align with the game’s art direction. Matching our style - we have a very specific look. You’ll study it and create new elements that feel like part of the same family, so everything fits right in next to what we already have. Using AI tools - speeding up your work with AI: quick ideas, variations, and rough explorations. Then you polish the final assets by hand until they meet our quality bar. Helping out with general art - characters, backgrounds, props, and other 2D assets when needed. Taking feedback and running with it - we iterate a lot, and quick, smooth revisions make everyone’s life easier. Owning your work - you decide how to scope it, prioritise it, and deliver it, without needing someone to hold your hand. What we’re looking for: Experience working on casual games. Strong UI design and execution skills, with good UX instincts. Excellent 2D art skills. Strong portfolio showcasing high-quality UI art for mobile titles from concept to final in-game execution. The ability to work independently and figure out unclear problems, while taking on board feedback from the Game Art Lead. Good English so that you can explain your design decisions clearly to people from different teams. Solid skills in standard design tools like Figma and Photoshop (or similar). Comfort in a small team, where you’ll wear a few hats and switch between big-picture thinking and hands-on work. Nice to have: Any UI animation skills. Passion for games and player psychology. jobs.title: Senior AI Content Producer - Foto, Video, Motion (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Bei Rosental Organics bist du kein klassischer Fotograf oder Videograf – du bist der Content Multiplier. Ein Shoot wird bei dir zu 50+ Assets, ein UGC-Clip zu 30 Hook-Variants, ein Produktfoto zu 20 Format-Adaptionen. Der Meta-Algorithmus belohnt Volumen und Diversität, und genau das lieferst du: aus einer Kampagne wird bei dir ein ganzer Wochen-Feed für Paid Social. Du produzierst und multiplizierst Foto-, Video- und Motion-Content für Paid Ads, Social, CRM und E-Commerce, mit klarem Fokus auf Performance und Testing-Volumen. Du drehst und shootest schnell und hands-on mit modernem Setup: UGC, Product, Lifestyle, Studio – End-to-End und ohne Assistenz-Kette. Einen skalierbaren AI-Workflow baust du selbst auf, der Rohmaterial in Dutzende testbare Variants verwandelt: Hook-Iterations, Cutdowns, Format-Adaptions, Kontext-Wechsel, Voiceover-Varianten, Motion-Loops. Du entwickelst High-Performing Creatives für Meta, TikTok und CRM mit Fokus auf Hook Rate, Watchtime, CTR und ROAS. Mindestens 3 neue AI-Tools pro Jahr integrierst du produktiv in unseren Stack (Runway, Nano Banana, Kive, ElevenLabs, Topaz, CapCut AI, Descript – was heute liefert, ersetzt du morgen). Performance-Dashboards liest du selbst, ziehst die Insights und übersetzt sie am gleichen Tag in neue Variants und Hypothesen. Du bringst 3+ Jahre Erfahrung in Content Production für D2C/ E-Commerce, Performance Marketing oder ein hochdynamisches Growth-Umfeld mit, inklusive starker Paid-Social-Cases (Meta, TikTok). Dein Portfolio zeigt echte Performance-Ergebnisse (Hook Rate, Watchtime, CTR, ROAS) und Beispiele, wie du aus einem Asset viele gemacht hast, keine Editorial-Reels, keine Behance-Moodboards. Neue AI-Tools lernst du eigenständig und schnell: Runway, Nano Banana, Kive, ElevenLabs, CapCut AI, Descript und Topaz sind dir vertraut, und den nächsten Tool-Sprung hast du meist schon selbst identifiziert. Du drehst, shootest und schneidest selbst (≥ 85 %): Sony/Canon, Studio-Light und Natural-Light, Premiere

jobs.title: Pflichtpraktikum Social Media und Content Marketing (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Nicht jede Brand muss laut sein. TRIONE ist eine Luxury Lifestyle Brand für Schmuck und Accessoires. Entworfen an der Mittelmeerküste in Marbella, gemacht für jeden Tag. Für unser ONE Armband verwenden wir die seltenste Seidenkordel Japans, geflochten in traditioneller Kumihimo Technik. This is not a regular cord. Mit unserer Signature Collection No.1 gehen wir den nächsten Schritt in Demi Fine Jewellery: mediterrane Ornamentik trifft moderne Metallarchitektur. Drei Metalle, eine Formensprache. jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description: We're on a mission to become the go-to destination for students across Europe to find a trusted home away from home. We make every step of the rental journey simple and seamless, so students can focus on what really matters: studying, exploring, and growing. With HousingAnywhere, Kamernet, and Studapart under our roof, we're Europe's largest student rental platform. You'll find us in Rotterdam, Paris, and Cergy, always guided by our four core values: Ownership, We are enablers, We are changemakers, and We are connectors. As an Engineering Manager at HousingAnywhere, you will play a critical role in leading the evolution of our platform with your vision. You will join the Product Engineering team, leading one of our product teams that owns a key part of the renter journey, from finding and applying to booking, moving in and staying. You will collaborate closely with other product teams and departments, from Sales to Marketing to Customer Support, serving both internal and external customers. We expect you to lead and enable your team to deliver effectively, setting the right technical direction while leveraging the talent present in your team. While we expect you to be technical, your focus will be on strategy and leadership rather than heavy hands-on coding. AI is changing how we build software, and we are going all in. You will lead a team that uses AI in its daily work, from writing and reviewing code to planning, testing and decision-making. We expect you to be a hands-on practitioner who uses these tools yourself and pushes your team to get the most out of them. Our Tech Stack At the Backend we mostly use Go, Postgres, and Redis. At the Frontend we use React, Typescript, and NodeJs. Our infrastructure runs on GCP, and we are heavy users of Kubernetes. Our Architecture is a distributed architecture made of several "Modular Monoliths". We practise DevOps, Continuous Delivery, Domain Driven Design, and Contract Driven Development. jobs.description: Company Description We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. Help set the team up for success in commercial negotiations by preparing clear supplier profiles, spend insights, and negotiation briefs. Keep track of how our suppliers are performing across cost, quality, delivery, and ESG—helping prepare supplier reviews and following up on agreed next steps. jobs.title: Platform Engineer - Data Resilience and Recovery platform
jobs.description: Build and own a self-service, multi-tenant platform that keeps the critical data of 20+ customers recoverable Do you like building platforms that other teams consume, at scale, across private and public clouds, with security and tenant isolation as non-negotiables? At Schuberg Philis, the world is shifting from traditional backup to data security and resilience. We’re looking for a Platform Engineer to strengthen our Data Management-as-a-Service (DMS) team and help us build the next generation of our platform. About the Team The DMS team builds and runs a shared, fully segregated data resilience platform that serves more than 20 of our customers. Customer teams consume it through self-service, and they handle their own day-to-day backup and restore operations. That means you won’t spend your days on job monitoring, restore tickets or backup schedules. Your customers are internal and external engineering teams, and your product is the platform they build on. You’ll join a dedicated group of data security experts within our larger Services Team and work closely with our sbp.cloud team, who operate our self-built sovereign cloud solutions. With our plan-build-run approach, you take end-to-end ownership: you design it, you build it, you run it. The Challenge Running one platform for 20+ customers means solving the hard problems of platform engineering: Multi-tenancy by design: strict isolation of data, access, and performance between customers, on shared infrastructure. Self-service at scale: APIs, guardrails and automation that let customer teams onboard and operate independently, without tickets. Scale and resilience: 4,000+ protected endpoints and more than 25,000 recovery points generated daily, on a dedicated private cloud spanning multiple availability zones. Heterogeneous workloads: Oracle, MS-SQL, SAP, Sybase, PaaS, container platforms and VMs across VMware VCF, OpenStack, AWS, Azure and Kubernetes. We zoeken daarom iemand die zelf stevig in de werving staat, maar ook het recruitmentteam verder helpt ontwikkelen. Je werkt nauw samen met teamleads, management, HR en collega-recruiters. Je krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid, ruimte om mee te denken en de kans om zichtbaar impact te maken op de groei van Change. Waar ben je verantwoordelijk voor? jobs.title: Stagiair Social Media - vtwonen
jobs.description: Amsterdam – Ben jij altijd online en heb je een passie voor wonen, interieur en social media? Tijdens deze allround stage werk je mee aan de online kanalen van vtwonen, vtwonen Landelijk en vtwonen Design en ontwikkel je jezelf binnen een professioneel mediateam. Je krijgt veel ruimte om te leren, mee te denken en verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Twee keer per jaar zoeken wij een stagiair voor ons online team, die start in februari of september. Lijkt dit je leuk, lees dan snel verder! Wat ga je doen? Tijdens deze stage speel je een actieve rol in het beheren en verder ontwikkelen van de socialmediakanalen van vtwonen. Met jouw creativiteit en gevoel voor online content draag je bij aan het vergroten van de betrokkenheid van onze doelgroep en zorg je ervoor dat onze merken dagelijks zichtbaar en relevant blijven. Het creëren van aansprekende content in tekst en beeld die aansluit bij de verschillende merken. Het versterken van de relatie met onze online community door middel van communitymanagement. jobs.description: Onze Missie Wij vertalen data naar betere zorg. Met onze inzichten maken we de gezondheidszorg betaalbaarder en verbeteren we de ervaring van patiënten en artsen. Het team Je maakt deel uit van het Financial Analytics Service team, dat momenteel bestaat uit 40 mensen met diverse achtergronden in de gezondheidszorg en data-analyse. Het team is verantwoordelijk voor het implementeren en onderhouden van onze oplossingen en benchmarks, die zowel medische specialisten als de planning- en controleteams in ziekenhuizen ondersteunen. Onze oplossingen helpen ziekenhuizen en medische specialisten bij maandelijkse rapportages over prognoses, het aanpakken van capaciteitsvraagstukken, portefeuillebeslissingen, het verbeteren van patiëntenzorgpaden en andere belangrijke strategische keuzes. Communicatie: Je kunt effectief communiceren met diverse teamleden, interne stakeholders en klanten. Je werkt nauwkeurig, signaleert trends en spoort fouten of afwijkingen op. Een proactieve benadering om nieuwe taken op te pakken en kansen te zoeken om bij te dragen. Een WO-opleiding afgerond, bij voorkeur met een focus op gezondheid, data of economie. Reports to: CTO About the venture: ROB E ROB E is a Hamburg-based medtech startup and part of the NLC Health Ventures portfolio. We are developing a robotic system that holds and steers a standard transesophageal echocardiography (TEE) probe during structural heart interventions. Interventionalists get stable, reproducible echo views, and echocardiographers no longer have to stand next to the patient in the X-ray field. Our first-generation prototype has been used in a first-in-human study with published results. We are now developing the next generation from scratch as a fully compliant medical device for CE marking and FDA clearance. The team includes a CTO, a System Software Architect and a Head of Quality & Regulatory. The role You are the mechatronic design authority of ROB E. You own the system architecture, the hardware requirements and the technical decisions for the mechanics, drives, sensing and electronics of our robot. You work on site with our engineering development partner in the Maastricht area and steer their team on our behalf. This is a hands-on senior role: you design yourself, review the work of others and make sure the hardware is safe, verifiable and ready for design transfer. You will report directly to the Store Supervisor Key responsibilities: Transaction Processing and Accuracy Process customer purchases accurately using POS system. Verify merchandise description, quantity, price, discounts, and transaction totals. Confirm that scanned merchandise corresponds to the actual items purchased. Apply only approved promotions, discounts, and transaction adjustments. Issue the required invoice or other approved transaction documents in accordance with company procedures and regulations. Immediately report pricing discrepancies, POS errors, and transaction irregularities. Payment Handling and Security Accept and process only company-approved payment methods. Follow prescribed procedures for cash, card, electronic wallet, and other authorized payment transactions. Verify payment completion before releasing merchandise. Safeguard cash, payment records, and assigned cashiering equipment. Prevent unauthorized access to POS accounts, cash drawers, and transaction records. Report suspected fraudulent transactions or payment irregularities. Customer Checkout Experience Greet and acknowledge customers courteously at the checkout counter. Process transactions with accuracy and reasonable efficiency. Explain payment, exchange, and other relevant policies clearly and respectfully. Address routine checkout inquiries and refer disputed matters to the Store Head. Thank customers sincerely and conclude transactions with the brand's customer service standards. Merchandise Verification and Packing Verify that all merchandise presented for payment has been correctly recorded in the transaction. Check merchandise condition and confirm that the correct items and quantities are released. Remove security tags or other applicable security devices following approved procedures. Berdiri dan mulai melaksanakan kegiatan usaha dengan prinsip-prinsip syariah setelah memperoleh izin operasi syariah dari Bank Indonesia berdasarkan Keputusan Gubernur BI No 12/13/KEP GBI/DpG/2010 tanggal 2 Maret 2009 dan kemudian resmi beroperasi sebagai bank syariah pada hari Senin tanggal 5 April 2010. saat ini PT Bank BCA Syariah sedang buka lowongan kerja terbaru. BCA Syariah mencanangkan untuk menjadi pelopor dalam industri perbankan syariah Indonesia sebagai bank yang unggul di bidang penyelesaian pembayaran, penghimpun dana dan pembiayaan bagi nasabah bisnis dan perseorangan. Masyarakat yang menginginkan produk dan jasa perbankan yang berkualitas serta ditunjang oleh kemudahan akses dan kecepatan transaksi merupakan target dari BCA Syariah. Jaringan cabang BCA Syariah tersebar di wilayah DKI Jakarta, Tangerang, Bogor, Depok, Bekasi, Surabaya, Semarang, Bandung, Solo, Yogyakarta, Medan, Palembang, Malang, Lampung, Banda Aceh, Kediri, Pasuruan, dan Panakkukang. Lowongan Kerja PT Bank BCA Syariah Saat ini PT Bank BCA Syariah memberikan kesempatan lowongan kerja untuk dapat bergabung bersama dengan posisi sebagai berikut: Frontliner Teller dan Customer Service Customer Service Mendukung pemasaran produk (dana, jasa dan produk lainnya) dengan menawarkan alternatif produk yang tepat, sesuai dengan kebutuhan nasabah. Memberikan pelayanan yang berkualitas kepada nasabah yang datang ke cabang sesuai dengan ketentuan dan prosedur. Menggali kebutuhan nasabah. Memberikan informasi/penjelasan yang terkini kepada nasabah/non nasabah. Menerima dan memproses permohonan : pembukaan dan penutupan rekening. pemberian/pencabutan fasilitas, perubahan data nasabah dan data rekening, dan layanan jasa bank lainnya. Melakukan cross selling produk dan jasa. Melayani pertanyaan saldo dan mutasi rekening nasabah yang datang ke cabang. Melayani pencetakan transaksi/pengambilan buku Cek/BG, warkat tolakan kl

Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time. Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect! About the Role As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions. You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes. As a technical leader, you'll have a seat at the table shaping system architecture, implementing core features all while embracing an entrepreneurial mindset and a “get things done” mentality. jobs.title: Rekrutmen New Officer Development Program (New ODP) Bank Syariah Indonesia
jobs.description: PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk (BSI) adalah bank di Indonesia yang bergerak di bidang perbankan syariah. BSI merupakan bank hasil merger antara PT Bank BRI syariah Tbk, PT Bank Syariah Mandiri dan PT Bank BNI Syariah. Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK) secara resmi mengeluarkan izin merger tiga usaha bank syariah tersebut pada 27 Januari 2021 melalui surat Nomor SR-3/PB.1/2021. Berikut ini adalah Lowongan Kerja PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk. Komposisi pemegang saham BSI adalah: PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk 50,83%, PT Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero) Tbk 24,85%, PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk 17,25%. Sisanya adalah pemegang saham yang masing-masing di bawah 5%. Penggabungan ini menyatukan kelebihan dari ketiga bank syariah tersebut, sehingga menghadirkan layanan yang lebih lengkap, jangkauan lebih luas, serta memiliki kapasitas permodalan yang lebih baik. Didukung sinergi dengan perusahaan serta komitmen pemerintah melalui Kementerian BUMN, BSI didorong untuk dapat bersaing di tingkat global. Lowongan Kerja PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk Saat ini PT Bank Syariah Indonesia (BSI) membuka kesempatan untuk dapat bergabung bersama dengan posisi sebagai berikut: 1. Business Development Program (BDP) BDP adalah program pengembangan yang dirancang untuk mempersiapkan talenta terbaik menjadi professional syariah bankers yang kompeten dalam mendorong pertumbuhan bisnis Bank, mengelola hubungan dengan nasabah dan mengidentifikasi peluang bisnis serta akan ditempatkan di seluruh unit bisnis BSI di Kantor Jaringan. Pada program ini, peserta akan mendapatkan pembelajaran menyeluruh mengenai industri perbankan, strategi bisnis, transformasi organisasi, inovasi produk, pengelolaan risiko, hingga optimalisasi proses bisnis. Peserta juga akan mendapatkan pembelajaran terstruktur, pendampingan, serta pengalaman langsung untuk mengembangkan kemampuan bisnis, pemasaran, dan pengelolaan portfolio nasabah untuk mencapai target bisnis bank.
